notes.title: Update 1.1.10 – System Improvements & TPS Fest
notes.content: [h1][b]\[1.1.10][/b][/h1][p]We’re getting ready to release [b]Update 1.1.10[/b] for [b]Protocol:null[/b] very soon![/p][p]This update brings [b]new content, gameplay improvements, optimizations, and balance changes[/b] to keep the experience smoother and more engaging.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New Attachment: Coller[/b] – improves regeneration for the [b]AN-4 Pistol[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Objective Indicator[/b] – clearer tracking of mission objectives.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Car & Gameplay[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improved [b]car movement system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Higher spawn chance for [b]car upgrades[/b] (Airfoil & Frontlip).[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer [b]objective visuals[/b] with updated car scenario textures.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Characthers[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Large improvements on [b]camera system[/b] and mouse sensitivity.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]character rotation[/b] – camera no longer rotates with the character.[/p][/*][*][p]Better handling on some [b]walkable surfaces[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Enemies[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjustments to [b]enemy despawn system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments on round system.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced overall [b]weapon recoil[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]ACOG zoom[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Faster [b]AN-4[/b] [b]pistol cooldown[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]AN-4[/b] [b]pistol capacity[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Optimization[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced [b]poly count[/b] on scenario vehicles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated car scenario textures[/b] – better visualization and clearer objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]bullet system performance[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned – [b]Update 1.1.10 is just around the corner[/b], and will also be featured during the [b]TPS Fest[/b]![/p][p][/p]
